content: The FrTp module shall always call the service primitive PduR_FrTpRxIndication after PduR_FrTpStartOfReception succeeded . The result shall be E_OK if a) all N - SDU data are received and b) all required response N - PDUs (FlowControl) are transmitted and TxConfirmation was given .
